takeaway: Releases work independently. ifc-git can join through an adapter.
notes: Agree on the smallest interoperable envelope: source and target release digests, persistent model/entity references, typed change records, coverage, profile version and required capabilities. Matching algorithms, parser implementations and user interfaces can change independently. Unknown required semantics must be reported rather than silently ignored.

Support ifc-git through an adapter rather than make it the mandatory gateway. Preserve its native delta and identity map in the artifact, and expose a versioned common query representation with defined consistency rules. The adapter is a proposal, not a claim that IFClite already ships an OCI integration. The cited discussion and scope reconciliation establish direction rather than completeness of the implementation.

Profiles describe artifact kinds, encodings and semantics. An IFCX layer represents model opinions; an OCI layer is a transfer blob. Composition order and native extensions must be explicit when used. An ordinary IFC delivery remains exchangeable without layers, branching, merging or ifc-git. Authorship, acceptance and authority decisions can be additional records linked to exact release/change digests.
